text_block_list.text: One day, during training—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ramonu-san is running! And her 
training partner is Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Say. Could you pass me some water?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——...Here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aren't those two acting kind of 
distant...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san and Kris S-san are roommates, 
right? I wonder if they're always like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When I saw them at the cafeteria, they 
were sitting side by side, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
They didn't talk at all? Hmm... I wonder 
if they're like that in their room too?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, that'd feel so awkward... I 
couldn't imagine never talking to Cesario 
for whole stretches of time!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... but it didn't seem like they were 
on bad terms, you know. Especially Kris 
S-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To me, it looked like they were both quite 
relaxed.

A few days after overhearing that 
conversation— While walking down the 
hallway, I noticed something dropped on 
the floor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——Excuse me. That is——mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
For picking it up——thanks. ——I was looking 
for it.
choice_data_list:
That's footage of past overseas races, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ordered——from America. Ramonu, asked 
for it——...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I am watching it now. Without delay.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——I see. ——Glad if it helps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...They speak quickly. That English just 
now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
——'Number 10's closing speed is 
phenomenal'...... is what they said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And, how did you see it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That——final stretch. With proper 
strategy—— the other runners——had a 
chance, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh? Won't you tell me more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
After that——we exchanged opinions. 
Ramonu's views were——fascinating.
choice_data_list:
Could it be you two get along surprisingly 
well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: As for that——...I do not know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But——Ramonu does not pry——into others. I 
am also——not fond of, talkativeness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thus——I feel at ease. With her——as a 
roommate.
choice_data_list:
Oho...! Out of curiosity, what do you two 
do on days off?

That sounds like an ideal roommate 
dynamic!

That sounds like an ideal roommate 
dynamic!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thus——I feel at ease. With her——as a 
roommate.
choice_data_list:
Oho...! Out of curiosity, what do you two 
do on days off?

That sounds like an ideal roommate 
dynamic!

That sounds like an ideal roommate 
dynamic!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm——... ............Occasionally, she 
shows me——paintings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu's art is——abstract. But——intensely 
captivating.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. To some—— it might appear——cold.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However, this is our—— proper——distance.
